items.q: Why do Tier-1 founders in Bengaluru and Delhi-NCR choose Trai Inc?
items.a: Tier-1 founders face exorbitant burn rates and high developer churn in Bengaluru and Delhi-NCR. Trai Inc delivers senior engineering pods out of our Global HQ in DLF MyPad, Lucknow, with seamless online collaboration and agile sprint delivery for founders across Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR, Cape Town, and globally. You get elite, battle-tested software architects at 40% lower burn with zero compromise on code quality.

items.q: Who actually writes the code? Are projects handed off to junior developers?
items.a: Never. We operate an anti-agency model with dedicated senior engineering pods. Every pod is led by a Staff/Lead Software Architect with 8+ years of production experience. We do not bill for junior interns learning on your budget.

items.q: How do you guarantee 100% intellectual property ownership?
items.a: Our contracts are unambiguous: upon milestone payment, 100% of the intellectual property, copyright, patent rights, architecture schematics, and source code belong exclusively to your company. You receive full GitHub repository access from day one.

items.q: Can your AI agents integrate with our legacy enterprise databases and ERPs?
items.a: Yes. Our team specializes in headless API adapters, zero-downtime ETL pipelines, and secure private VPC connections. Whether your data lives in SAP, Oracle, Postgres, or legacy internal spreadsheets, we architect secure, rate-limited connectors with zero data leakage.

items.q: What is your milestone payment cadence?
items.a: We work on transparent, milestone-driven sprints (typically 1 to 2 weeks each). You review and verify working software and automated test suites at each milestone before approving subsequent sprint funding. Zero large upfront lock-ins.

items.q: Can we transition to an in-house engineering team later?
items.a: Yes. We design all architectures using modular, idiomatic conventions (clean architecture, strict TypeScript typing, Dockerized microservices, comprehensive documentation) specifically so your eventual in-house technical team can take over seamlessly without rewrites.
